title: Quick K Maize Ugali
description: A simple and earthy Kenyan dish made with maize flour and sweetened with raisins and candy, perfect for a quick solo dinner. This gluten-free-friendly recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: Combine maize flour and water in a saucepan and whisk until smooth.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add raisins and chopped candy to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the raisins are soft and the mixture is thick.
Remove from heat and serve hot.
